title: Tool output issue: read_file — cache-hit response omits inline content forcing external Read tool fallback
description: mcp__moeb__read_file returns a backreference string ('CACHE HIT: <path> — content already sent at turn N (sha256: ...). File is unchanged. Use the content from that turn.') when a file has not changed since its last read in the current session. After context compaction, the prior turn content is no longer in the active context window, making the backreference unusable. This forces the agent to fall back to the native Claude Code Read tool (an external non-moeb tool) to obtain the file content. Observed 3 times in run c6af8022-8df4-4edf-8bb0-97b1a8dda8b8: signal.schema.json, accept_candidate.rs, accept_candidate.skill.md.
proposed_resolution: Update read_file to always return the full inline file content in its response regardless of prior reads in the session. If the cache-hit optimization is retained, it should include the actual content alongside the backreference, or be suppressed after context compaction has occurred. This would eliminate the forced external Read tool fallback that currently causes moeb-tool-origin rubric failures.
